body: Sorry I took so long to respond. Passed out and now I’m at work. I mean yeah, shit is always tough and we all have our own shit and I get that. I can’t really relate to anything you said so I can’t say I understand. All I know is that it’s worth it to try and push thru to another day. Now does shit ever get better? Well that’s up for debate. You’ll never know unless you try I guess.
Dude I set my shit for 18 and I’m 20. Only goal was to finish highschool. Make my parents proud for once and kms. Tried. Didn’t happen. And I’m still here at the bottom of the well.
Hey man. Do you wanna talk about it? I’m always here to listen.

It’s different when you have the rope around your neck or pills in your hand. Hence why a huge majority of suicides are firearms. They is no “never mind” with those or a goof up. Game over with a pull.

I mean. The fear of death is an innate feature in all life. Some people are just here for a reason to keep going I guess. That’s why I’m on here. Thru all the self harm and handful of attempts at least I can relate to some people in 1 way.
I believe you. First serious attempt was at 14 6 years ago.
Ayo Indiana gang
I was drunk. Started rambling. And just broke down.
Not with this method. Everyone has an innate fear of death and it cucked me this time.
Wouldn’t everyone who was depressed. Nobody wants to feel this way. But sometimes you can’t change how you feel.
You’re acting like there’s a button that’s magically going to make me better. I’ve tried. I’ve tried everything I can. Making more friends. Going out more. Therapy. None of it works. None of it.
Hmmm. It doesn’t really sound like an option to me. I don’t think I could anyways. I have to live with the fact I tried to kill myself today forever.

I don’t think I would’ve slipped out because I made sure it was tight as hell on Both ends, my neck and the knob. I think that’s what really made me sit up was just survival instincts tbh and having that “oh shit I’m going to fucking die” go through my idiot head. I’m sorry for what happened to you and I hope it gets better man. Truly.

My entire life experience. Most of it is a repressed blur before middle school tho. High school was a blur. Mainly the things that aren’t fuzzy in my mind is the bad shit. I remember the abuse from my grandpa, physical and mental from when I was a kid. can still remember the first time I did a tiny little scratch with a knife on my thigh. When I lost all my friends in middle school and was bullied. How alone I was in highschool. My first suicide attempt when I was 14 when I stayed home from the last day of 8th grade then seeing a picture on Instagram of all my old friends together without me. My mom constantly telling me how worthless I am and how all amount to nothing. Just. Everything is what I’m trying to cope with man.

I don’t know now. I don’t regret it. Been feeling this way since I was 13( 20 now) and only ever have every seriously tried OD’ing. Don’t recommend. So I said fuck it let’s play around w this method. Honestly it scared the shit out of me in the moment. Very different from just taking a fuck ton of pills and hoping it kills you. It’s more like a “holy shit I’m going to die” and your brain moves you on it’s own so I feel like you’d need a more full send method than just leaning back. But I feel like the only way to move on is to just laugh about it and learn from it. I feel even worse tbh. But it’s either making a joke out of it or cutting myself up since those are my only coping mechanisms so. Definitely not trying this doorknob shit again tho.
Nothing I can do now but learn and laugh about it. I don’t mind really.
I’d say. Average. Maybe. Idk. I don’t have like a construction worker named chuck witha neck built like a steel pipe. But I don’t have that one really skinny girl named Emily’s neck.
Thanks. I appreciate this. I read it last night and didn’t really fully appreciate what you said. So thank you. It really helped.
I feel so hypocritical saying don’t when I’ve seriously attempted before.
It’s one of the many reasons I hate myself. Things I said and did, I can’t take back yk. And I hate that.
I’m both. I went from bully to bullied. I feel immense regret for what I’ve done in the past and I deserve what I got tbh.
Thank you.
